$comment: Single source of truth for the wordsteer step vocabulary (cf. ExcelLLMAddin shared/providers.json). Names and units follow quds tool/fidelity/office_steps.dart: lengths in points, lineSpacing as a multiple, colours as six hex digits. 'engines' lists who implements an op natively; tests/test_ops_spec.py fails when an engine adapter and this file disagree. 'write': true ops change the document (agents should confirm them, as ExcelLLMAddin's write tools do).

target.find: exact text inside one paragraph of the main story (case-sensitive)
target.select: instead of find: 'word' | 'sentence' | 'paragraph' | 'shortParagraph' — the recipe resolver picks a text that occurs exactly once in the input document
target.nth: with select: which candidate (default 0; 'middle' picks the middle one)

params.text: string (inserted as a new paragraph after the target's paragraph)
